details: U.S. Consumer Price Index (CPI) data for June 2026, released today, showed inflation cooled more than economists anticipated. Headline CPI came in at 3.5% year-over-year (vs. 3.8% forecast), and core CPI was 2.6% (vs. 2.8-2.9% forecast). This softer inflation report has eased fears of aggressive monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve.
title: US June CPI Falls Below Forecast, Lifts Crypto Outlook

details: Renewed hostilities between the U.S. and Iran have led to a spike in oil prices, heightening inflation concerns and triggering a broader "risk-off" sentiment in financial markets. Bitcoin, the largest cryptocurrency, saw a decline as a result, along with other risk assets.
title: Bitcoin Slips Amid US-Iran Hostilities and Inflation Fears

details: For the week ending July 10, U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded approximately $197 million in net inflows, while spot Ethereum ETFs saw $84.42 million in net inflows. This marked the end of an eight-week streak of weekly net outflows for both products, indicating a return of institutional capital to crypto asset exchange-traded funds.
title: Bitcoin & Ethereum ETFs End 8-Week Outflow Streak with Net Inflows

details: President Donald Trump called on the U.S. Senate to approve the "Clarity Act," which passed the Senate Banking Committee with bipartisan support. This bill aims to establish a clearer regulatory framework for digital assets, defining the roles of the SEC and CFTC. Separately, the "21st Century ROAD to Housing Act," which includes a provision prohibiting the Federal Reserve from issuing a central bank digital currency (CBDC) through 2030, officially became law.
title: Trump Urges Senate to Pass Crypto Clarity Act; CBDC Ban Enacted

details: The European Central Bank (ECB) has selected 36 payment service providers to participate in a 12-month digital euro pilot, set to begin in the second half of 2027. Negotiations on the legal framework for a digital euro also commenced, with the aim of finalizing legislation by year-end for a potential launch in 2029. The ECB has expressed concerns that stablecoins could pose risks to financial stability.
title: ECB Taps 36 Providers for Digital Euro Pilot Amid Stablecoin Concerns
